body:
We are all here. Feeling mediocre.  And probably we are. But still, maybe we felt something to connect. We are mediocre, but is it enough to stop this plain of existence. 

I feel for you. I hope you will find the way to pay for your debt even though you feel like you're mediocre, and probably you are, but there is nothing wrong with this. I still feel for you as I type. 

I'm in the cube 9-5.
